item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! ### **🌳 Cedarvale Ravine & Nordheimer Ravine Walk**
Come explore two of the most historic and peaceful ravines in Toronto — nestled in some of the city’s most beautiful and wealthiest neighbourhoods.
These quiet, tree-lined trails were once popular retreats for Toronto’s elite during the turn of the century — perfect for cooling off, taking long strolls, and even a bit of hunting back in the day! This walk takes us through **Cedarvale Ravine** and **Nordheimer Ravine**, offering a glimpse into Toronto’s rich natural history — and yes, there will be **ice cream at Dutch Dreams** to reward ourselves at the end!

item.title: Summer Concerts - China Court Duo — Thu Jul 23, 7:00 PM — Toronto Reference Library
item.description:
China Court Duo features three elegant Chinese traditional instruments Pipa (Chinese lute) , Xun (Globular vessel flute), and Dizi (Bamboo flute). The two masterful musicians Wen Zhao (PIpa) and Yucheng Zhang (Xun and Dizi) focuses on performing Court repertoires and traditional folk music from the Ming and Qing dynasty, the program includes spirited ancient poem repertories in China, and Wen Zhao's recent composition for the silk string Pipa Dynasty, a suite work traces the history of the Pipa through three of China's imperial dynasties. For more information, contact the Arts Department at 416-393-7157. Thursday, July 23, 2025, 7 :00 – 8:00 p.m. Beeton Hall, Toronto Reference Library

Practice your English conversation skills in a welcoming environment, while making new connections and learning about other programs the library has to offer! All English levels are welcome. Please note that this is *not* a formal English class. This is a drop-in program.
Source: Toronto Public Library — Adults
